title: 多階層速率整形、有效速率計算與宿主保底頻寬 (Multi-Tier Rate Shaping, Effective Rate & Host Reserve)
expected: Effective rate is min(plan_rate_limit, fup_tier_rate, exit_per_member_limit) per direction, never below minimum_rate when forwarding is allowed; node installs tc HTB + fq_codel on fv0 (download) and eth0 (upload) with host reserve class 1:2 protecting the control channel.
actual: Isolated kernel netns fv_at18 inside fvpn-w4-usage-node verified real Linux kernel tc HTB + fq_codel installation on fv0 and eth0 with host reserve class 1:2 and per-member classes 1:10/1:11, and fup.EffectiveRate verified min(plan, tier, exit) and minimum_rate floor. Live overlay throughput measurement is blocked because node publication returns HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE and device_bindings=0.
blockers: Live member overlay throughput measurement under multi-tier shaping is blocked because PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b/publication returns HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE and device_bindings count=0.
